Definition: from G4012 and G2572; to cover all around, i.e. entirely (the face, a surface):--blindfold, cover, overlay.
BiblicalUsage: Perikalypto means to cover all around, entirely. The ark of the covenant was overlaid round about with gold, and the soldiers blindfolded Jesus, struck Him, and demanded He prophesy who smote Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I am convinced that gold can cover the ark and a blindfold can cover the Lord's eyes — but the covering does not change what is underneath.
